package_name: Stratus Red Team — AWS / Credential Access

description: Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for AWS targeting the Credential Access tactic. Each script invokes the official Stratus binary using an isolated Morgana correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation. Prerequisite cloud infrastructure is managed by Stratus warmup. Cleanup is performed via the separate cleanup_command using the same correlation ID.
purpose: Validate AWS Credential Access detection rules, SIEM alerts, and SOC workflows in an authorized cloud sandbox.
capabilities: 5 Stratus Red Team techniques for AWS Credential Access.
Official Stratus binary execution — no custom attack code.
Morgana Test ID used as Stratus correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation.
Separate detonate + cleanup lifecycle with state preservation.
use_cases: Validate AWS Credential Access detection in an authorized cloud sandbox.
Exercise SIEM, CSPM, cloud-native detection, and SOC workflows with real cloud API activity.
Confirm detection rules fire on real technique execution before incident response exercises.
prerequisites: AWS credentials configured on the Agent (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET, AWS_PROFILE, or IAM instance profile).
IAM permissions appropriate for the techniques being tested.
Authorized test AWS account — never run against production workloads.
safety_notes: Stratus Red Team is designed for authorized sandbox cloud environments only.
Never execute against production cloud accounts, subscriptions, or clusters.
Some techniques create real cloud resources that incur cost — always run cleanup after detonation.
Warmup may take 1–5 minutes for Terraform-based infrastructure setup.
Cleanup uses the same correlation ID; ensure MORGANA_TEST_ID matches the detonation Test.

scripts.name: STRATUS - AWS - Retrieve EC2 Password Data
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for AWS.

Retrieve EC2 Password Data

Runs ec2:GetPasswordData from a role that does not have permission to do so. This simulates an attacker attempting to retrieve RDP passwords on a high number of Windows EC2 instances. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_GetPasswordData.html Warm-up: - Create an IAM role without permissions to run ec2:GetPasswordData Detonation: - Assume the role - Run a number of ec2:GetPasswordData calls (which will be denied) using fictitious instance IDs

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Retrieve EC2 Password Data
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_profile}" ]; then export AWS_PROFILE="#{stratus_aws_profile}"; fi
if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_region}" ]; then export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="#{stratus_aws_region}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=aws.credential-access.ec2-get-password-data"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate aws.credential-access.ec2-get-password-data
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=aws.credential-access.ec2-get-password-data"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"aws.credential-access.ec2-get-password-data\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup aws.credential-access.ec2-get-password-data
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=aws.credential-access.ec2-get-password-data"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT

source_metadata.detection: Identify principals making a large number of ec2:GetPasswordData calls, using CloudTrail's GetPasswordData event

scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for AWS.

Steal EC2 Instance Credentials

See also: [Known detection bypasses](https://hackingthe.cloud/aws/avoiding-detection/steal-keys-undetected/).
